translations.web: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.
translations.bsb: Immediately Zechariah’s mouth was opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak, praising God.
translations.kjv: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
